checked.name: Papad
checked.detail: Stored {calories:370, protein:24, carbs:60, fats:3, fiber:6}. Two external sources found during micronutrient research disagree with the stored figure AND with each other, consistent with papad being a highly recipe/brand-variable product (lentil type, oil content, frying vs roasting): (a) a generic/commercial papad source: {calories:371, protein:25.6, fat:3.3, carbs:59.9, fiber:18.6} - fiber is 3.1x the stored value; (b) an IFCT-tested plain urad papad: {calories:307.41, protein:15.2, fat:0.283, carbs:65.08, fiber:7.25} - fiber still >15% over stored, and protein/fat differ substantially from the stored figure in the opposite direction from source (a).
checked.recommendation: The stored fiber value (6g) looks low against both independent sources (18.6g and 7.25g) - worth a dedicated look, since both disagreeing sources at least agree stored fiber is too low. Protein/fat are harder to adjudicate given how much papad composition varies by brand/recipe; not recommending a specific correction without picking which real-world papad formulation this app means to represent.
